messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "use extra care to prevent bleeding while shaving or brushing teeth"
set: ["use extra care to prevent bleeding while shaving or brushing teeth", "use extra care while shaving or brushing teeth", "taken once daily at bedtime, after brushing your teeth", "teeth grinding", "to prevent dizziness", "use non-hormone birth control method to prevent pregnancy", "stress ulcer bleeding prophylaxis in critical care setting", "bleeding or bruising", "this does not usually prevent their use", "taking aspirin to prevent heart attack or stroke", "prevent choking", "prevent dehydration", "do not use extra medicine to make up the missed dose", "extra facial hair", "easy bruising or bleeding", "unusual bruising or bleeding"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
